description: Cold/warm startup and time-to-interactive budgets for apps/mobile, measured on the Expo web build under a throttled low-end profile (Pixel 5 + 4× CPU + Fast 3G). Enforced by scripts/check-mobile-startup.mjs; see docs/app-startup-budget.md.
notes: Measurements are produced by e2e/startup-budget.spec.ts and written to mobile-startup-measurements.json (gitignored).
CI emits ::warning:: when a metric passes warningMs; exceeding maxMs fails the job.
Native cold start is not measured in CI (no emulator on default runners); these numbers proxy bundle parse + first paint on web.
